'''Gearan''' was an [[Da'shain Aiel]] who lived during the latter years of the [[Breaking of the World]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Gearan|comp}}

==Appearance==
He was lanky and the best runner among the wagons.

==History==
On an ill-fated attempt to rescue some kidnapped girls, Gearan and a group of friends killed the kidnappers in self defense, thus becoming the first Aiel to stray from the Way of the Leaf. Gearan and the others were exiled from the other Da'shain Aiel. The dust veils Gearan and his friends wore to keep off the dust became the shoufa worn by the Aiel in the later years.{{ref/book|4|25}}

==Errata==
He is listed as [[Jenn Aiel]] in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], but the term Jenn did not exist until years after he was exiled. He should be Da'shain Aiel.{{ref||comp}}
